# Missing Metric Dimension Fixture

## Quality Attributes
Quality attributes are covered.

## Success Metrics
- Trigger performance: ≥90% true positives across 5 positive prompts and ≤10% false positives across 5 negative prompts.
- Task completion: ≥95% of acceptance checks pass.
- Task completion speed: 100% of tasks finish within 60 minutes.
- Time-to-working-skill: new author creates a valid skill within ≤60 minutes.
- Residual defect density: zero Critical defects remain after validation.
